name: Enthalpy v0.4.28
notes:
# Enthalpy v0.4.28

## Changes

- Sign-in, Workspaces, Account settings, and Workspace settings use separate
  screens. Your account email makes the active account clear.
- Sign-out returns to Sign in and closes workspace access. An expired session
  requires sign-in again. Downloaded files remain available offline while the
  session is valid.
- Unsaved edits are kept if a final save fails when the session expires. Sign
  in to the same account to resolve the save problem.
- Open and Create use one workspace list. Workspace names stay consistent
  across screens. Folder paths appear in details, and Sync shows the last
  successful update time.
- Workspace creation and download keep non-secret form entries when you visit
  Account settings. Passwords and passphrases are cleared.
- Removing a device shows the required security update and its result. Removed
  access no longer shows an unusable Unlock Sync action.
- Moving a workspace to Trash keeps its local files and connection record.
  Restore can open the same local copy without another download.
- Password reset and account recovery report when email delivery is
  unavailable. They no longer tell you to wait for email that cannot be sent.

## Test this preview

Sign in and check the account email. Create or open a workspace. Open its
settings, then return to the workspace list. Sign out and check that only
Sign in remains. Sign in again to open the downloaded files.

## Known limits

Recovery email is not available. After a workspace is restored from Trash,
this preview cannot restore its devices' Sync access. Existing local files
remain available after sign-in. The original OneDrive failure still needs
further testing.
